Multiple evacuations ongoing along the San Juan River due to flooding. As many as 1500 homes and buildings are estimated to be impacted by flooding. Over 60 water rescues are estimated to have taken place_ primarily between Farmington and Bloomfield since Thursday afternoon.

A tornado developed in the Via Caballero neighborhood in the south central portion of Santa Fe just north of I-25. The tornado traveled northward for approximately 1.4 miles_ terminating near the College of Santa Fe. Much of the damage was along Rancho Siringo and Camino Chueco Roads. Damage included broken power poles_ uprooted or damaged trees_ damage to roofs. Ten homes sustained damaged. This tornado has been given a preliminary rating of EF-1_ pending additional information.
